player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Library, failing to realize that the "north" direction was still available and likely led to an unvisited room (since I had previously entered the Library from the south and west, but never explored the north exit from this specific instance). My strategy of stopping immediately upon returning to a previously visited room was flawed because it didn't account for unexplored exits within that room. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of which specific directions have been attempted from each room. I will only declare "DONE" when I am in a room and have no untried directions available, or when I have confirmed all reachable rooms have been visited. Specifically, in the Library, I should have tried "GO: north" before concluding the task.
